How to use
Yellow cells are the ones you fill in; everything else is reference data.
AI Result (A1–A3): paste the raw answer AI Studio gives for that row's question.
Result: pick the final verdict from the dropdown after you have checked the AI answer against the live site.
Columns D–E (A sheets) are the working block next to the question; URL, Claim and the can/can't note sit to the right for reference.
A1–A3: CONFIRMED / REFUTED / CANNOT VERIFY. B: also CONFIGURATION (intentional hours/pause toggle); REFUTED = the "FALSE if" case.
C: NOT LISTED / LISTED - FAIR PRICES / LISTED - INFLATED (compare 3 menu-item prices with their own site).
The # column keeps the numbering from the combined audit file, so rows are not consecutive in A1–A3.
